content:
{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Former federal judge J. Michael Luttig warned Thursday that President Trump is launching a "final battle" against American democracy, writing in a lengthy op-ed in The New Republic that Republicans may steal the midterms.'}

{'role': 'user', 'content': '"Today, almost six years later, Donald Trump and his Republican allies in Congress are more determined than they were on Jan. 6, 2021, to bring the President\'s war on American democracy to its catastrophic conclusion," wrote Luttig, who was appointed to the bench by George H.W. Bush and is a conservative.'}

{'role': 'user', 'content': '"That catastrophic conclusion will likely arrive on Jan. 3, 2027, when Trump and his Republican allies in Congress will fight what could be the final battle in Trump\'s self-initiated war to corrode American democracy and deal American\'s a lasting political defeat," he continued.'}

{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Trump, who refused to accept his loss and concede to then-President Biden, has since floated running for an unconstitutional third presidential term as "payment" for what he falsely claims was a "stolen" election—lies that ultimately fueled the Jan. 6, 2021, Capitol riot.'}

{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Luttig warned that the leader of the Make America Great Again (MAGA) movement has no intention of enduring such a humiliation again.'}

{'role': 'user', 'content': '"Trump and his Republican allies have been preparing for this final battle ever since Jan. 6, 2021," wrote Luttig. "For six years now, they have denied Trump\'s loss in the 2020 presidential election—absurdly, at all costs, and to their shame and the nation\'s."'}

{'role': 'user', 'content': '"Every unconstitutional action Trump takes to seize control of the midterms—all cheered on by his servile Republican Congress—are aimed at ensuring that Republicans maintain their majority in the 120th Congress," Luttig warned.'}

{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Trump is facing disastrous approval ratings and a struggling economy against the backdrop of a nationwide cost-of-living crisis, as well as his unpopular war against Iran. But he\'s decided to frame the midterms as a referendum on his "record." However, many conservative commentators are predicting a bloodbath for the GOP.'}

{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Luttig expressed his lament over the downfall of the GOP during the Trump era. He recalled that Republicans used to at least "claim fidelity to the Constitution, principles, truth, honesty, integrity—and even honor," but now appear to be at his beck and call, beholden to his explicit or implicit demands of loyalty.'}

{'role': 'user', 'content': "Trump has installed a slew of election deniers and stacked key positions in the DOJ with loyalists. He's also tried to unilaterally change state and local election laws, insisted on unprecedented access to voter rolls, and threatened election officials."}

{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Luttig called on Americans to "disenthrall" themselves from Trump\'s "political thralldom," closing with words from former President Abraham Lincoln, who in 1863 "earnestly endeavored to disenthrall the Nation from the thralldom of then-existing destructive political heresies."'}

{'role': 'user', 'content': '"The Republican Party especially must at long last throw off the yoke of its political and moral enslavement to Donald Trump, and dissociate itself from the MAGA political party cult. The writing is on the wall, Republicans," he warned.'}
